text_post: If you broke up, you should not be seeing each other anymore, or talking about your relationship. If you are seeing each other still, then you probably shouldn't break up just yet - you might have genuine feelings for each other. author: sdnightfly
text_post: If I know my ex is going to be with her friends at a club, then I would find somewhere else to go. But if you didn't know, you should've just given each other eye contact, a wave, and go back to talking to your friends, maybe later talking to her for a minute, even buying her a drink... but if she pretended not to see you, you can just find it amusing that she's being a little girl about it.  Once it's over with someone, for the time being, don't bother with her. If you see her, be polite even if she's ignoring you or being rude to you. Just go "she's hurt and she's not my problem anymore. If she has anything on me, all I can do is hope she doesn't start using the internet to DLV me or tell her friends some serious dirt, but she prob. already has." Usually if you're able to spend a couple of months apart, things settle out and you both move on. It's those first few weeks that you have to just reconnect with your guy friends and start putting your feelers out for other girls. No rush... if she didn't destroy your inner game, a few approaches and a #-close or two will help you out in moving on fast.  Anything under 6 months, you can usually move on in weeks. If it's a LTR that lasted years, takes a little longer, but if the relationship started dying months before the breakup, you're usually ready to date pretty quickly.
